description_en: Adds IP addresses to the IP blacklist for WAF critical event protection
description_zh: 添加WAF重保场景防护IP黑名单
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-2r42s6y0000 --template-id 2221 --rule-id 232324 --ip-list 192.0.XX.XX,192.0.XX.XX/24 --expired-time 1716528465 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMajorProtectionBlackIp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the critical event protection rule template.

This parameter requires the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after you purchase the critical event protection upgrade.

For more information about how to enable critical event protection and create a critical event protection rule template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
重保场景防护规则模板ID。

本参数需传入重保场景防护类型的防护模板ID。重保场景防护需单独升级购买后才可创建该类型模板。

开通重保场景防护及新建重保场景防护规则模板的具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html文档
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the critical event protection IP blacklist rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses to add to the IP blacklist. Custom IP addresses and CIDR blocks are supported. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
添加的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The expiration timestamp, in seconds.
If the value is 0, the rule takes effect permanently
parameters.help_zh:
生效截止时间戳，单位为秒。
取值为0时，表示永久生效
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The description of the IP blacklist
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
